reference.description: re-computes the Hilbert envelope |scipy.signal.hilbert(x)| per channel and compares to emgEnvelope's; reports the machine-precision agreement (max |diff| < 1e-9), the channel count (32), the mean envelope amplitude (0.058), and the mean peak/mean modulation (6.47, the gesture's burst activity)
